paragraphs.text: Plots must be cultivated: if more than half a plot is weeds in July, the committee sends a warning letter and may end the tenancy after a second warning. Sheds need permission and may not exceed 6 square metres.

Hoses may be used only between 6 pm and 8 am. Bonfires are permitted from November to February, on Saturdays only. Dogs must be kept on the paths; children are welcome but remain the responsibility of the plot holder.

items.quote: may end the tenancy after a second warning
items.prompt: A plot can be taken away after one warning.

explanation.en: The tenancy ends after a second warning → FALSE.
explanation.kk: Телімді екінші ескертуден кейін алады → FALSE.
explanation.ru: Участок забирают после второго предупреждения → FALSE.

items.quote: Sheds need permission and may not exceed 6 square metres
items.prompt: Permission is required before building a shed.

items.quote: Hoses may be used only between 6 pm and 8 am
items.prompt: Hoses may be used at midday in summer.

explanation.en: Hoses are allowed only between 6 pm and 8 am → FALSE.
explanation.kk: Шланг — тек 18-ден 8-ге дейін, түс кірмейді → FALSE.
explanation.ru: Шланг — только с 18 до 8, полдень не входит → FALSE.

items.quote: children are welcome but remain the responsibility of the plot holder
items.prompt: Children are not allowed on the allotments.

explanation.en: Children are welcome, under the plot holder’s responsibility → FALSE.
explanation.kk: Балалар қарсы алынады, бірақ телім иесінің жауапкершілігінде → FALSE.
explanation.ru: Детям рады, но под ответственность владельца → FALSE.
